li.label: ch Boxer
li.description: Excels at unarmed combat. When unarmed, melee damage becomes absurd.

li.label: ch Tex
li.description: A natural gunfighter. Gains better ranged accuracy, faster aiming, and faster follow-up shots with any firearm, then becomes absurd with revolvers.

li.label: ch Tank
li.description: Extremely resistant to injury. Damage is heavily reduced. Movement is less impacted by injury.

li.label: ch Green Thumb
li.description: Plants near me grow faster and ignore darkness and temperature penalties.

li.label: ch Artificer
li.description: Everything I make is at least excellent: 60% excellent, 30% masterwork, 10% legendary. Covers crafted items and sculptures.

li.label: ch Engineer
li.description: A master builder. Construction never fails, finishes in a fraction of the time, and every structure raised is at least excellent: 60% excellent, 30% masterwork, 10% legendary. Sculptures stay the Artificer's domain.

li.label: ch Alchemist
li.description: Food is alchemy. Meals cooked by this pawn grant temporary buffs, never cause food poisoning, and sometimes come out perfect.

li.label: ch Doc
li.description: All surgeries performed by this pawn succeed. Tend quality is always excellent, including self-tend.

li.label: ch Ascendant
li.description: This pawn's intellect borders on the prophetic. Research crawls along at ten times the normal rate, and every quadrum a flash of insight — a Eureka — exposes two random discoverable recipes on a trait-gated Eureka Forge for three in-game days.

li.label: ch Beastmaster
li.description: Absolute dominion over animals. Taming and training are effectively guaranteed. Nearby colony animals are blessed with improved survival, productivity, and fighting ability.

li.label: ch Diplomat
li.description: Master of persuasion. Prisoners break faster, ideologies convert faster, trade deals improve, and social interactions land with overwhelming force.

li.label: ch Digger
li.description: This pawn tears through rock and pulls far more from every vein.

li.label: ch Comfy
li.description: This can extinguish nearby fires and place comfort nodes which heat/cool even large rooms with no electricity.

li.label: ch Tesla
li.description: This pawn can deploy tesla coils which generate power for free and zap nearby enemies.

li.label: ch Wizard
li.description: A born spellcaster. This pawn doesn't need a psylink or psyfocus — the weave answers them directly. Comes with a personal spellbook of four cooldown-based spells: a long-range Lightning Bolt, map-wide Teleport Other, a Mass Berserk pulse that turns hostiles on each other, and a Super Soldier conjuration that wraps a friendly pawn in Legendary spacer-tier gear for two in-game hours.

li.label: ch Bard
li.description: A battlefield support hero. This pawn projects a commanding aura that empowers nearby colonists, and the longer an ally stays inside it the stronger the blessing grows. The Bard can switch the aura between four stances — War Anthem (offense), Bulwark (defense), Vigor (sustain), and Heroic Boon (reflexes and toughness) — with a short cooldown between changes.
